counters.read_accounting_scope: hash full-file bytes + nominal torch.load bytes; proc rchar/read_bytes separate; safetensors mmap/library/image-decode reads not individually instrumented

compute_resources.monitoring: RSS/wall use a 1s sampling schedule; each counter snapshot may add <=2s control-lock waiting plus I/O/scheduling; thresholds unchanged; torch allocator peak sampled at 0.5s; cooperative kernel scheduling; 30s own-group TERM grace

process_cleanup.method: unreaped session anchor, start_ticks and pidfd; adopted owned zombies reaped

review_read_accounting: max(proc rchar, startup rchar + hash and mmap nominal payload bytes + double pinned JSON bytes + 100000 source/control allowance)
review_scope: read_world plus binding/signature/manifest/completion/receipt checks; no model recomputation or labels
